title: Coming out after retirement: Daily Mail and Ty Roberts interviews
place_text: UK Daily Mail; International UFO Bureau (Oklahoma City)

tellings.quote: >> on on the 4th of May, uh Josh Boswell came out with uh an interview uh from the UK Daily Mail.

plain: A doctor who worked with NASA, the US space agency, named Greg Rogers says he went public after retiring, first in an interview with the journalist Josh Boswell published by the UK Daily Mail newspaper on 4 May 2025, then in an interview with a man named Ty Roberts at the International UFO Bureau in Oklahoma City for a programme called Total Disclosure. Rogers tells this first-hand; he is the man who says he saw a UFO in a secret hangar, and these interviews are where he first told that story.
